answers.core: In many ways, signals act as containers for callables. A `clear()` function is basic functionality that should be expected of such a container. (Again, imagine if such a function was not present in arrays or dictionaries.)
answers.workaround: As described above, this enhancement can be worked around by iterating through connections and disconnecting them individually. However, the purpose of this enhancement is to circumvent this workaround for convenience.

title: Add a disconnect_all function to signals
